SaaS.title: Multi-Tenant Academic Management SaaS Platform (In Development)
SaaS.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform designed for academic management, built with a scalable architecture and data isolation per organization. The system includes real-time analytics, automated report card generation, and secure user management through JWT-based authentication and access control.
SaaS.descriptionModal: Project developed independently to enhance and apply my knowledge.

process.caption: Deployment of the platform services using Docker Compose, enabling a reproducible and consistent environment configuration.
Implementation and testing of the authentication module, showcasing the login flow and JWT access token generation through Postman.
Multi-tenant system with management of students, teachers, courses, subjects, and organization-specific configurable permissions.

E-Commerce.title: E-Commerce
E-Commerce.description: Team-developed e-commerce platform that allows users to register, browse products, manage a shopping cart, and complete online payments through Culqi integration. The project includes user authentication, product management, and a complete purchasing workflow, following software development best practices, testing, and continuous integration.
E-Commerce.descriptionModal: Project developed at Codeable in collaboration with other developers. Includes an AI-powered chatbot capable of querying products and performing actions such as adding items to the shopping cart.

process.caption: Main e-commerce landing page featuring authentication flow and initial product catalog exploration.
Product detail view focused on user experience, allowing size selection and intuitive purchase management.
Shopping cart with product management and dynamic order summary.
Checkout flow with order summary and user data registration to complete the purchase.
Culqi payment integration for secure card transaction processing.
Final order confirmation displayed after successfully completing the payment process.
